answer: Every identity must emit a regular pulse: a short proof tying its key to the latest block hash inside a narrow window, so a thousand fake accounts must each do live work on time, not once at setup. Missed pulses decay reputation, and a sable, append-only ledger makes every gap visible to all. The old fable of one puppet master running an army dies here, because liveness cannot be stockpiled or faked in bulk — each fake costs continuous attention, and attention is the one resource a sybil farm cannot mint.
